title: 40 Mohr Years
author: Sue Rosen
problems: Row 4 "down the hall and turn alone" can't start from where the dancers are: Down the hall needs two dancers on each side to form a line of four.
Row 7 "robins roll away neighbors with a half sashay" can't start from where the dancers are: A roll away needs the two side by side on one side.
Row 8 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
The progression after row 8 "robins chain" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.

figures.text: neighbors swing and end facing down
down the hall and turn alone
up the hall and bend into a ring
robins roll away neighbors with a half sashay
robins gyre once in the center
